candidates.title: Earthborne Rangers
blockers: The complete Lure of the Valley campaign guide, rules glossary entries, and core-set errata entries were inventoried but not retrieved and inspected page by page.
The rulebook makes rules-bearing card text controlling over the basic rules, but no authoritative distinct-card identity and text corpus was acquired.

coverage.methodology: Rules coverage counts six identified governing source groups for the scoped English core set: rulebook, Lure of the Valley campaign guide, rules glossary, FAQ, updates/errata, and rules-bearing card text. A group counts only when completely retrieved and inspected; only the 48-page rulebook closed. Factual distinct-record coverage remains unscored because the official source exposes physical card totals but no authoritative distinct-card denominator.

gap.threshold_summary: Governing-source-group coverage is 1/6 (16.7%) against the required 6/6 (100%); distinct factual-record coverage is unscored because its authoritative denominator is unavailable.
missing_evidence: Retrieve and inspect all 96 Lure of the Valley campaign-guide items rather than only the official category inventory.
Retrieve and inspect every core-applicable rules-glossary entry, all 16 card-errata items, all 35 Lure campaign-guide errata items, and the first-printing rulebook update.
Acquire an authoritative core-set distinct-card identity and rules-text inventory, or obtain an explicit T-level ruling that physical-card representation is sufficient despite duplicate copies.

attempted_sources.result: Retrieved the official inventory, which exposes 96 Lure of the Valley items, but the bounded run did not inspect every linked item.
Retrieved the glossary landing page and its 22 alphabetical categories, but did not close the full entry-level denominator.
Retrieved the updates inventory showing 16 card errata and 35 campaign-guide errata items, but did not inspect every core-applicable item.
The unauthenticated BGG XML API returned HTTP 401, so no rating, rank, or complexity claim is included in this packet.

help_requested: Provide or authorize a machine-readable, authoritative core-set card identity and rules-text inventory if one exists outside the public resources index.
Confirm whether a future packet should scope only the current corrected English core set or separately account for first-printing rulebook and card errata applicability.
